title: Operating Policy
content:
RPcore Operating Policy

Effective Date: March 1, 2026  |  Version: 2026.03.01

RPcore establishes and operates the following operating policy for healthy community environment and safe service use.

Article 1 (Scope of Application)
This operating policy applies to all users within the RPcore service.

Article 2 (Prohibited Acts)
① Creation and sharing of illegal content
② Infringement of others' rights (defamation, copyright infringement, etc.)
③ Hate speech, discriminatory language use
④ Content that causes sexual shame
⑤ Violent, cruel expressions
⑥ Aggressive remarks against socially vulnerable groups
⑦ Spam, advertising content
⑧ Acts that interfere with service operation

Article 3 (Content Regulation)
① Even AI-generated content can be restricted if it violates the operating policy.
② Violating content is discovered through user reports or automatic detection systems.
③ Violating content can be deleted without warning.

Article 4 (User Sanctions)
① First violation: Warning and content deletion
② Second violation: 7-day service suspension
③ Third violation: 30-day service suspension
④ Fourth violation: Permanent service suspension

Article 5 (Youth Protection)
① Implement measures to protect users under 19 years of age.
② Operate harmful content filtering system.
③ Strictly prohibit creation of youth harmful media.
④ Provide guardian consent function.

Article 6 (Intellectual Property Rights Protection)
① Prohibit content that infringes others' copyrights.
② Even public materials must indicate sources.
③ Respect trademarks, patents, and other intellectual property rights.

Article 7 (Personal Information Protection)
① Cannot collect or use others' personal information without consent.
② Prohibit disclosure of sensitive information such as real names, contact details.
③ Strictly prohibit cyberstalking, identity theft, etc.

Article 8 (Community Guidelines)
① Aim for respectful communication culture.
② Encourage healthy criticism and discussion.
③ Prohibit bullying, group ostracism, etc.
④ Refrain from provoking political, religious conflicts.

Article 9 (Report and Processing Procedure)
① Users can report violating acts.
② Review begins within 24 hours after report receipt.
③ Processing results are notified to reporters.
④ False reports can be sanctioned.

Article 10 (Objection Procedure)
① Can apply for objection to sanctions within 7 days.
② Operator reviews objections and notifies results within 14 days.
③ Third-party review committee can be established to ensure fair procedures.

Article 11 (Policy Changes)
① Notify 7 days before policy changes.
② Obtain user consent for major changes.
③ Changed policies take effect after notification.

Article 12 (Responsibilities and Obligations)
① Operator strives for fair policy operation.
② Users comply with policies and create healthy communities.
③ Use service based on mutual respect.

Supplementary Provisions
This operating policy shall take effect from March 1, 2026.
